list.title: Journal entries
list.description: Draft, posted and reversed accounting entries.

presets.saveBody: The selected filters and parameters are kept in this browser under this name.
presets.name: Name

export.label: Export
export.failed: The file could not be downloaded.

lines.title: Entry lines
lines.applyBase: Write the base amount to line {{index}}
lines.keys: F9 or = : put the difference on this line · Enter after a debit skips credit · Ctrl+S saves the draft
lines.maxReached: An entry can have at most {{max}} lines.

validation.amountRequired: Enter a debit or a credit amount.
validation.bothSides: A line cannot carry both a debit and a credit.
validation.costCenter: This account requires a cost center.
validation.fxAmount: A foreign-currency account needs an FX amount.
validation.fxRate: A foreign-currency account needs a rate.
validation.maxLines: An entry can have at most {{max}} lines.
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 500 characters.

editor.description: Enter the lines with the keyboard; post once the entry balances.
editor.postNeedsBalance: Debit and credit totals must be equal to post.
editor.deleteBody: The draft entry and its lines are deleted permanently.

post.title: Post the entry?
post.body: A posted entry gets its journal number; it cannot be changed afterwards, only corrected with a reversal.
post.doneBody: The entry was given journal number {{number}}.
post.unbalancedNow: The entry no longer balances and was not posted. Reload it and check.

reverse.title: Reverse {{number}}
reverse.body: A new entry with debits and credits swapped is created and linked to this one.
reverse.reasonRequired: The reason must be at least 3 characters.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this entry
conflict.body: Load the latest version before saving; your edits are not merged.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.loadFailed: The data could not be loaded.
errors.refreshFailed: The latest version could not be fetched; what you see may be out of date.

reports.choose: Choose the parameters and run the report.
reports.periodsFailed: The periods could not be loaded.

trialBalance.title: Trial balance
trialBalance.description: Opening, period movements and balances per account; debit and credit totals are checked.
trialBalance.unbalanced: Out of balance · movement difference {{movement}} · balance difference {{balance}}

ledger.title: General ledger
ledger.description: Opening balance, movements and running balance of one account.
ledger.choose: Choose an account and a date range, then run the report.

book.title: Journal book
book.description: Posted entries in number order; every page shows brought and carried forward totals.
book.empty: No posted entries in this range.
book.tooLarge: The range is too large to show on screen; narrow it or export.
book.changed: New entries were booked while the journal book was loading, so the totals do not match. Reload it.

changed.title: The entry changed elsewhere
changed.body: A newer version was saved while you were editing. Load the latest version before saving your changes.
